phases.name: The Serpents Hunger
phases.say: They have not eaten today. They are not particular.

say.open: I took a throne once with a kiss on each shoulder. I can take yours with less.
say.death: Feed... them... someone has to feed them...

bestiary.lore: A usurper who let the Lie kiss his shoulders and woke with two serpents growing there, which must be fed each day on the minds of men. He ruled a thousand years. The Barrows kept him when his kingdom died.
bestiary.weakness: Holy and Fire. Keep Sanity up: the serpents feed on the least sane, and their Mark calls down the King's own blow.
bestiary.pattern: The serpents feed on the least sane and Mark them; every third turn the King strikes whoever is Marked; fangs on a row and decrees that silence between. At half the serpents feed every other turn.
